about: compiler/objfmt/wasm: pure-Ergo DoD WebAssembly 1.0 + bulk-memory binary emitter and structural decoder/validator. Every mutant breaks one binary format, LEB128, section ordering, opcode, local compression, data segment, or decoder validation invariant.

mutants.name: wasm-uleb32-drop-cont-bit
mutants.rule: Canonical ULEB32 multi-byte encodings must set continuation bit 0x80 on all non-final bytes.

mutants.name: wasm-sleb32-drop-sign-check
mutants.rule: Canonical SLEB32 termination requires checking bit 6 of the final byte against the sign of the remaining shifted value.

mutants.name: wasm-sleb64-wrong-shift
mutants.rule: SLEB64 encodes 7 payload bits per byte and must shift by 7.

mutants.name: wasm-uleb32-allow-overlong-zero
mutants.rule: Strict ReadULEB32 must reject non-minimal overlong encodings with redundant trailing zero bytes.

mutants.name: wasm-uleb32-skip-highbit-check
mutants.rule: Strict ReadULEB32 must reject 5th-byte encodings that set unused bits above bit 31.

mutants.name: wasm-sleb64-skip-final-sign-check
mutants.rule: Strict ReadSLEB64Bits must validate canonical sign extension on the 10th byte.

mutants.name: wasm-wrong-magic-header
mutants.rule: WriteHeader must write the exact 4-byte \0asm magic preamble.

mutants.name: wasm-section-order-datacount-after-code
mutants.rule: DataCount section (12) must appear strictly before Code section (10) in canonical WebAssembly section order.

mutants.name: wasm-wrong-datacount-sec-id
mutants.rule: DataCount section must use canonical WebAssembly section ID 12.

mutants.name: wasm-bulk-copy-flag-dropped
mutants.rule: MemoryCopy must mark UsesBulk so the emitter emits DataCount section 12.

mutants.name: wasm-mem-copy-missing-second-zero
mutants.rule: memory.copy (0xfc 0x0a) requires both destination and source memory index bytes (0x00, 0x00).

mutants.name: wasm-codebuf-else-ignored
mutants.from:
if n == 0 || c.IfStack[n-1] != uint8(1) {
		c.BadElse = true
mutants.to:
if n == 0 || c.IfStack[n-1] != uint8(1) {
		c.BadElse = false
mutants.rule: CodeBuf.Else must flag BadElse when emitted outside an open If block.

mutants.name: wasm-locals-no-merge
mutants.rule: CompressLocals must merge consecutive locals of the same value type into run-length entries.

mutants.name: wasm-code-body-drop-end
mutants.rule: Every WebAssembly function body in the Code section must terminate with 0x0b (end).

mutants.name: wasm-data-passive-mode-wrong
mutants.rule: Passive data segments in section 11 must use segment mode tag 0x01.

mutants.name: wasm-emit-allow-dup-export
mutants.rule: ValidateModule must reject duplicate export names.

mutants.name: wasm-emit-allow-bad-limit
mutants.rule: Memory limits must reject maxPages < minPages.

mutants.name: wasm-decode-allow-out-of-order
mutants.rule: Decode must reject WebAssembly sections appearing out of canonical order.

mutants.name: wasm-decode-allow-dup-section
mutants.rule: Decode must reject duplicate standard WebAssembly sections.

mutants.name: wasm-decode-allow-datacount-mismatch
mutants.rule: Decode must reject modules where DataCount disagrees with the Data section count.

mutants.name: wasm-decode-allow-bad-align
mutants.rule: Memory load/store instructions must reject alignments larger than the instruction's natural width.

mutants.name: wasm-decode-allow-trailing-code
mutants.rule: Function body decoding must reject trailing instructions after the top-level 0x0b end.

mutants.name: wasm-decode-allow-immutable-global-set
mutants.rule: Code validation must reject global.set targeting an immutable global.

mutants.name: wasm-wrong-i32-add-opcode
mutants.rule: i32.add must use WebAssembly opcode 0x6a (not 0x6b i32.sub); live Bun and Node WebAssembly execution catches semantic opcode corruption.
